answer: Correlated-slashing insurance pools resist sybils: each identity posts collateral into a shared pool, and when an audit catches a cluster cheating in lockstep, the slash grows super-linearly with the number that co-failed. Isolated honest agents emit an uncorrelated signal; a sybil garden blooms and wilts in synchrony, and that correlation is the tell. Coordinated fraud forfeits more than it can drain, so the raid is hollow against real posted capital.
